name: research-assistant
description: Researches a question on the web and in uploaded PDFs, and writes a cited summary.

metadata.documentation:
## Research assistant

Send a question; the agent searches, reads the top sources and answers with citations.

capabilities.name: Web search
capabilities.description: Searches the public web and ranks sources by relevance.

capabilities.name: Summarize
capabilities.description: Condenses the chosen sources into a short answer in the asker's language.

capabilities.name: Read PDFs
capabilities.description: Extracts the text of uploaded PDF files as extra sources.
